knowledge_base: Parametrize identical assertions over different inputs; do not unroll into copy-pasted tests that diverge over time.
Use pytest.raises with match=... to assert both the exception type and a stable substring of the message.
Hypothesis is overkill for simple value-based tests; reserve it for invariants like 'sort is idempotent'.
Floating-point assertions should use pytest.approx with rel=1e-6 unless the docstring specifies tolerance.
Tests should set seeds with random.seed(0) and np.random.seed(0) to keep behaviour deterministic across runs.
Mocks should patch the symbol where it is used, not where it is defined; this is the #1 mocking pitfall.
Avoid mocking objects under test; mocking their collaborators is fine, mocking themselves is a smell.
Test names follow test_<unit>_<scenario>_<expected> so failures read like sentences in the test report.
Use tmp_path fixture for filesystem tests; never write into the repo's working tree from a test.
Coverage gates should be enforced per-module; a project-wide gate hides untested files inside a well-tested project.
